system.boundary: Build a one-lap kinetic-energy-recovery model for a high-performance vehicle.
engineering_objects: Build a one-lap kinetic-energy-recovery model for a high-performance vehicle.
The physical system must include longitudinal vehicle dynamics, a rear-axle motor-generator, a shared DC bus, a lithium-ion battery, and an ultracapacitor.
Braking must drive regenerative electrical power into the hybrid store, and acceleration assistance must return stored energy through the motor-generator.
physical_paths: Braking must drive regenerative electrical power into the hybrid store, and acceleration assistance must return stored energy through the motor-generator.
Battery and ultracapacitor currents and powers must come from their physical energy paths, with signs that distinguish charging from discharging.
Hard-coded scenario traces, copied scalar inputs, disconnected storage branches, fabricated Timeseries, or strategy signals that do not affect the physical power path are not acceptable.

modes_and_events: Build a one-lap kinetic-energy-recovery model for a high-performance vehicle.

interfaces.name: kers_input
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read kers_input from the MATLAB base workspace and simulate for at most 100 s; the lap may stop when it is complete, but a valid lap must last between 80 and 100 s. kers_input is a MATLAB struct with these public fields: strategy_mode is an integer scalar, with 0 using available KERS assistance at all acceleration opportunities and 1 using it only at selected high-value opportunities; battery_mass_kg is a real scalar in 0.5--3.0 kg; ultracapacitor_mass_kg is a real scalar in 1.0--8.0 kg; and motor_generator_mass_kg is a real scalar in 3.0--6.0 kg.

interfaces.name: vehicle_speed
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: vehicle_speed has width 1: vehicle_speed_kph, in km/h.

interfaces.name: traction
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: traction has width 3 in this order: motor_torque_Nm in N*m, motor_speed_rad_s in rad/s, motor_mechanical_power_W in W.

interfaces.name: storage_voltage
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: storage_voltage has width 3 in this order: battery_voltage_V, ultracapacitor_voltage_V, dc_bus_voltage_V, all in V.

interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: storage_current has width 2 in this order: battery_current_A, ultracapacitor_current_A, both in A.

interfaces.range_or_shape: storage_power has width 2 in this order: battery_power_W, ultracapacitor_power_W, both in W.

The physical system must include longitudinal vehicle dynamics, a rear-axle motor-generator, a shared DC bus, a lithium-ion battery, and an ultracapacitor.
The battery should supply energy-oriented support while the ultracapacitor carries the higher transient power.
